name: Transparency Log Integration
description: All signatures and attestations are published to Rekor. Consumers can verify inclusion.
purpose: Establish Rekor transparency log as the single source of truth for all signatures and attestations so consumers can verify inclusion and detect any signing anomalies.
acceptanceCriteria: All signatures are published to Rekor transparency log automatically.
All in-toto attestations are published to Rekor automatically.
Consumers can verify inclusion using Rekor's API or CLI (rekor-cli).
Failure to publish to Rekor fails the build/release step.
Rekor entry UUID is recorded in the release metadata.
Query by artifact hash returns all associated Rekor entries.
Rekor integration is tested in CI with both success and failure scenarios.
